approval_evidence.quote: BLA ACCELERATED APPROVAL BL 125388/0 ... August 19, 2011 ... Seattle Genetics, Inc. ... for ADCETRIS (brentuximab vedotin)

series_end_reason: Pfizer completed the acquisition of Seagen on Dec 14, 2023; Seagen filed no report for 2023Q4 (last 10-Q is for 2023Q3, Form 15 filed Dec 26, 2023). Pfizer's later Adcetris line (companion series pfizer_adcetris, from 2024Q1) is worldwide and includes royalty revenue, a different scope, so the series is not spliced.
search_log: listed Seagen (CIK 0001060736) filings via data.sec.gov submissions, all forms: 8-K Item 2.02 releases 2011-08 to 2023-11 and 10-Q/10-K 2011-2023 fetched
Before 2019Q4 Seagen prints only a 'Net product sales' row (ADCETRIS was the only product); the fiscal 2019 10-K prints ADCETRIS rows equal to it for 2018, 2017 and earlier
2019Q4 is read from the ADCETRIS row of the 2020Q4 release because the quarter's own 'Net product sales' includes PADCEV's first sales
From 2020Q1 the 10-Q ADCETRIS row is used for Q1-Q3 (thousands) and the release row for Q4 (millions)
Quarter sums agree with the full-year ADCETRIS figures (2020: 658.6, 2021: 705.6, 2022: 839.3, quarter sum 839.4 from rounding)
